patches.noetic-build: Use C++14, the OpenCV 4 core header, and -O2 -g0 for Noetic.
patches.unused-gtsam-header: Remove the unused unstable fixed-lag header. The IMU graph uses stable iSAM2.
patches.projection-input-bound: Skip empty clouds before reading the last point time.
patches.projection-and-feature-diagnostics: Record actual deskew and extracted feature counts.
patches.finite-scan-to-map: Skip undefined zero-distance line Jacobians, require full neighbors, and reject invalid pose updates.
patches.map-graph-diagnostics: Record factors only after iSAM2 accepts the batch and returns optimized estimates.
patches.imu-graph-diagnostics: Record actual integrated IMU sample count, factor insertion, accepted corrections and graph resets.

inputs.truth_frame: LiDAR origin via native offline IMU-link pose and rigid lever arm
